mentions.name: Fast Classifieds
mentions.description: This app automates browsing newly posted jobs across bookmarked smaller-company job boards, reducing the review time from an hour or two to about five minutes.
mentions.problem: The desired jobs are posted only on smaller company job boards, and manually browsing all bookmarked sites takes an hour or two each time.
mentions.audience: Job seekers looking for roles posted on smaller company job boards.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Fast Classifieds (https://travisbumgarner.dev/marketing/classifieds)
A lot of the jobs I'm looking for are on smaller company job boards only. It takes me about an hour or two each time I want to browse all the sites I have bookmarked. I made a little app that automates the process and reduces the time down to about 5 minutes to look through the new posts.
